cards.title: Shell-Shock (Under Playtesting)
incapacitatedAbilities: One player may play a card.
One player may draw a card.
Until the start of your next turn, increase all damage dealt by 1.

cards.title: Rooftop Reconnissance
body: Draw 3 cards.
You may use a power now.

cards.title: Zap-Lad
body: When one of your Vehicle targets would take lightning damage, prevent that damage and that Vehicle regains 1 HP instead.
At the end of your turn, this card deals 1 target 1 lightning damage.

cards.title: Shell-Copter
body: When this card enters play, destroy any of your other Vehicle cards in play.
At the start of your turn, this card deals itself 3 lightning damage.
Each Hero gains the following power:
[b]Power:[/b] {Shell-Copter} deals up to 3 targets 2 projectile damage.

cards.title: Canvas the Scene
body: Discard the top card of each deck.
If {ZapLad} is in play, put the top card of up to 2 trash piles on top of their deck.
If {ZapLad} is not in play, search your deck and trash for {Zap-Lad}, put it into play, and shuffle your trash into your deck.

cards.title: Vehicular Defense
body: After a non-hero target deals one of your Vehicle targets damage each turn, Shell-Shock deals that non-Hero target 2 melee damage.
powers: You may play a vehicle card.

flavorQuotes.text: They always expect me to {be}be the one driving.

cards.title: Shell-Buggie
body: When this card enters play, destroy any of your other Vehicle cards in play.
At the start of your turn, this card deals itself 3 lightning damage.
Each Hero gains the following power:
[b]Power:[/b] You may destroy an environment card. {ShellBuggie} deals 1 targets 3 melee damage.

cards.title: Plans and Payoff
body: After a vehicle target enters play, it deals 1 target 2 melee damage.
When this card is destroyed, you may destroy an Ongoing card and {ShellShock} deals 1 target 2 melee and 2 lightning damage.

flavorQuotes.text: Your speech was so long that my {br}reinforcements are here. Good job.

cards.title: Emergency Landing
body: After one of your Vehicle cards is destroyed, draw 2 cards and Shell Shock regains 1 HP.
powers: One of your Vehicle cards deals 1 target 5 melee damage. Destroy that vehicle card.

flavorQuotes.text: Mud is still a softer landing pad {br}than some of the things I've seen.'

cards.title: Measured Assault
body: Shell-Shock deals 1 targets 4 melee damage.
Shell-Shock deals up to 4 targets 1 lightning damage each.

cards.title: Knife-Fight
body: Increase melee damage dealt by Shell-Shock by 1.
Reduce melee damage dealt to Shell-Shock by 1.
powers: {ShellShock} deals up to 2 targets 2 melee damage.

cards.title: In the Weeds
body: When there is a device card in play, increase damage dealt by {ShellShock} by 1.
After the first time one of your targets deals damage each turn, {ShellShock} deals 1 target 1 lightning damage.
icons: I know how that hovercraft works. {br}There are some glaring weaknesses I can {br}take advantage of.

flavorQuotes.text: What? A tazer {br}is useful in an ambush.

cards.title: Eye from Above
body: The first time a non-Hero target enters play each turn, you may use a power.

cards.title: Shell-Glider
body: When this card enters play, destroy any of your other Vehicle cards in play.
At the start of your turn, this card deals itself 3 lightning damage.
Reduce damage dealt to {ShellShock} by 1.

flavorQuotes.text: I don't know why he insisted {br}on a geared-up hang glider, but {br}it's come in handy some days.

cards.title: Shell-Blimp
body: When this card enters play, destroy any of your other Vehicle cards in play.
At the start of your turn, this card deals itself 3 lightning damage.
Each Hero gains the following power:
[b]Power:[/b] Draw 1 card. This hero regains 2 HP.

cards.title: Left Unspoken
body: Draw 1 card. Shell-Shock regains 4 HP.
Another player draws 1 card. Their Hero regains 4 HP.

placeholderPromoCards.title: Team ShellShock
powers: {ShellShock} deals 1 target 1 energy damage. Select up to 1 target for each type of damage {ShellShock} has dealt this turn. Until the start of your next turn, reduce damage dealt to those targets by 1.
incapacitatedAbilities: One player may play a card.
Select a Hero.  Until the start of your turn reduce damage dealt to that Hero by 1.
Select a damage type. Until the start of your next turn, change all damage dealt to that type.

openingLines.default: Everything around us stands against you!

placeholderPromoCards.title: Chibi ShellShock
powers: Draw 1 card. Discard up to 1 card for each different type of damage {ShellShock} has dealt this turn. {ShellShock} deals up to 2 targets X fire damage, where X = the number of cards discarded this way.
incapacitatedAbilities: One player may play a card.
One environment target deals each non-environment target 2 fire damage and themselves 10 fire damage.

openingLines.default: I bet I have more of a blast than you!
